what_is_wrong: The survival tables for the day-14 and the day-3 rgH5N1 challenge (S06-C and S06-D) are identical, animal for animal: vehicle deaths on days 4, 4, 5, 6, 6, 6, 7, PSLN-212 deaths on days 5, 8, 10, 10, 12 with two survivors, no deaths in the other two arms. One of them is presumably a copy. S06-C agrees with its weight block (S15-C: no deaths on PSLN-344 or in young animals), although that weight block shares its PSLN-344 traces with S15-I (D7). S06-D does not agree with its weight block (S15-D: two deaths on PSLN-344 and two in young animals).
effect_on_conclusions: The table can count as one experiment, not two, and which challenge day it belongs to is uncertain. By its weight block the day-3 result for PSLN-344 would be 5 of 7, not 7 of 7.
how_handled: The table is counted once (as S06-C) in the headline figures and S06-D is left out of the rapid-protection figure. Table 2 shows the result with both copies removed.

what_is_wrong: The survival table lists the arms Sham, CMP-204, PSLN-212, PSLN-344, young; the weight block for 'the animals of S03-I' lists young, Sham, PSLN-212, PSLN-344, Naive. In the table PSLN-212 loses all 7 animals by day 6; in the weight block 'PSLN-212' has 3 survivors of 7 and the fast-dying pattern sits under 'Naive'.
effect_on_conclusions: PSLN-344 (7 of 7) and the young benchmark (7 of 7) agree in both blocks. The size of the PSLN-344 advantage over PSLN-212 in this experiment depends on which block is right (7/7 vs 0/7, p = 0.0006; or 7/7 vs 3/7, p = 0.07), and the 3-of-7 result printed for the cGAMP formulation may belong to PSLN-212.
how_handled: Excluded from the headline figures; shown as printed in Figure 1 with a flag.

what_is_wrong: The survival table lists Sham, PSLN-212, PSLN-344; the weight block for 'the animals of S03-J' lists PSLN-344, Sham, Naive. The table's 'Sham' (9 of 10 dead) behaves like the weight block's 'Naive' (9 of 10 dead); the table's 'PSLN-212' (7 dead on days 10–12) behaves like the weight block's 'Sham' (5 carried-forward traces and a sixth animal still falling at day 14). The block label states n = 9 but each arm has 10 records, and the tenth PSLN-344 record has no day.
effect_on_conclusions: PSLN-344 protects 10 of 10 against wild-type H5N1 in both blocks. Whether the comparator that protected 3 of 10 was PSLN-212 or vaccine with empty vehicle is unresolved.
how_handled: Excluded from the headline figures; the PSLN-344 arm is counted in the rapid-protection figure (10 of 10; 9 of 9 if the record without a day is dropped).

what_is_wrong: The IgG2a/IgG1 ratio blocks carry the right 30 values under the wrong headers: the column printed 'PSLN-344' holds the PSLN-212 ratios, 'PSLN-212(Y)' holds the PSLN-344 ratios and 'PSLN-212' holds the young ratios (every value reproduced from the subclass titres in S13-A to S13-D).
effect_on_conclusions: Read as printed, PSLN-344 would appear to give the lowest IgG2a/IgG1 ratio (0.58); the recomputed value is 2.14, close to young (2.97).

what_is_wrong: 35 of the 100 'neutrophil' values are identical, to the decimal, to the alveolar-macrophage value at the same group, day and animal position (chiefly the first animal of every group and the second animal of three groups); a further 5 (the second PSLN-212 animal) repeat the fourth PSLN-212 animal of the macrophage block.
effect_on_conclusions: There is no usable neutrophil data, which is the read-out one would want for lung tolerability.
how_handled: S11-B not used. Replaced by a BAL neutrophil endpoint in Study 3.

what_is_wrong: Both cytokine panels are labelled '16h'. The Ifnb1 row of the second panel reproduces the 72-hour values of S01-A for all seven groups (21 of 21 values), so the second panel is 72-hour data. The control column is labelled 'PBS' here and 'Sham' in S01-A for the same animals.
effect_on_conclusions: Taken at face value, the 72-hour inflammatory read-out would be mistaken for a replicate of the 16-hour one. Whether the control was buffer or empty liposome is unclear.
how_handled: Second panel treated as 72 h and flagged wherever quoted.

what_is_wrong: Body-weight traces recur across experiments that should be independent: all seven PSLN-344 animals of S15-C reappear in S15-I (40 of 42 values from day 2 to day 12 identical); in total 15 animal traces are shared between 5 pairs of blocks (including young BALB/c traces of S09-E reappearing as young C57BL/6 in S15-M). The day-12 row of S09-C is identical for PSLN-212 and PSLN-344 (8 values), and the day-4 vehicle row of S15-A equals the day-4 PSLN-212 row of S15-M (7 values). The chance of two unrelated animals sharing one value is under 1%.
effect_on_conclusions: Weight blocks cannot be treated as independent evidence. The survival tables paired with them are distinct from one another, apart from D1.
how_handled: Weights used only as supporting evidence (morbidity, and as a cross-check on survival tables).

what_is_wrong: S08-C, as printed, gives 13.8% dye-positive type I epithelial cells for the Mn-free liposome; S01-B gives 3.8% for the same measurement. Column B of S08-C (printed as the Mn liposome in type II cells, 3.8%) matches the S01-B type I value, which suggests columns B and C are transposed.
effect_on_conclusions: As printed, Mn²⁺ cuts delivery to the epithelium four- to five-fold; with the columns transposed it does not change it. The question is open.
how_handled: Not used for any conclusion; repeat requested in Step 0 / Study 1.

what_is_wrong: Conditions missing from the annotation: challenge virus, dose and day for the C57BL/6 and Swiss Webster studies (S15-L, S15-N); challenge day for the imprinting PR8 study; time points for S07-B, S11-E, S13-H and S14-A; animal age for S08-A; which adjuvant the pertussis-toxin groups received (S02-C, S02-E). 'PSLN-344/R848' (S08-A) is not in the materials list. Encapsulation of PSLN-R848 is reported by absorbance of CDN-1807, which that formulation does not contain. Manganese content is not reported, and it is not stated whether the 'sham' vehicle contains Mn²⁺.
effect_on_conclusions: The two non-BALB/c strain experiments cannot be classed as matched or mismatched challenge; no manganese dose can be calculated.
how_handled: Results used as printed with the gap stated.

what_is_wrong: Both columns are headed 'Ly6C-CD206+ MΦ'. One should be the Ly6C+CD206- subset.
effect_on_conclusions: The experiment shows that transferred macrophages change lung regulatory T cells (10.4% vs 5.1%) but not which subset does it.

what_is_wrong: Stated n differs from the records: S03-J states 9, has 10; S05-A and S05-B state 3, have 2 per time point; S13-E states 5, has 7; S09-F has 7 vehicle survival records for 8 animals in its weight block (the annotation attributes this shortfall to S09-B, which has 8); PSLN-212/R848 in S08-D has 4 of 5 animals on day 10.
effect_on_conclusions: No effect on the main conclusions. The missing R848 animal is probably a death and is counted as a tolerability signal.

what_is_wrong: The conditions are self-contradictory (animals 'immunised with ovalbumin' and also 'vaccinated with the bivalent vaccine'), the tetramer named (NP366-374) does not fit the default BALB/c strain†, and there are 2 animals per time point.
effect_on_conclusions: Tetramer data support the CD8 story (higher with PSLN-344) but cannot carry weight.
how_handled: Not used for any numbered claim.

what_is_wrong: Sheet S06 uses the labels S06-E and S06-F twice (rows 34–68: day-60 challenges; rows 71–105: imprinting studies).
effect_on_conclusions: Risk of citing the wrong block.
how_handled: Blocks cited with their row ranges.

what_is_wrong: Thirteen values (day 14, flag 0; 6 in column C, 7 in column D) with no block label, header or group names.
Dead animals are handled two ways in the weight blocks: cells left blank (mostly vehicle groups) or the last weight carried forward to day 14 (mostly adjuvant groups).
effect_on_conclusions: Group mean weight curves after the first death are not comparable between arms.
how_handled: Per-animal lowest weight used instead of group mean curves.

what_is_wrong: Survival tables and weight-implied deaths differ by one animal in five groups: S06-C PSLN-212 (5 vs 6 deaths), S06-E PSLN-212 (7 vs 6), S06-E PSLN-344 (2 vs 1), S06-G PSLN-344 (3 vs 2), S15-L young (1 vs 0).
effect_on_conclusions: Net effect on the PSLN-344 total across the eleven experiments is zero once D1 is included (68 of 80 either way).
how_handled: Survival tables used; worst-case reading reported (66 of 80 vs 15 of 80).
